newsitem.title: UK: Ghana weekly cocoa purchases drop to 1,468 T.
newsitem.headline: Ghana weekly cocoa purchases drop to 1,468 T.

text.p: Ghana weekly cocoa purchases amounted to 1,468 tonnes in the 22nd week of 1996/97 ending March 13 with the cumulative reaching 297,577 tonnes, the Ghana Cocoa Board said on Friday.
The latest weekly data compares with 1,983 tonnes in the previous week ending March 6.
In the 1995/96 season, purchases ran at 3,014 tonnes in the 23rd week which ended on March 14, with the cumulative at 339,623. By the 22rd week ended March 7, the cumulative was 336,609 tonnes.
Ghana ended its 1996/97 cocoa season on Thursday but the board said final returns on purchases would be accepted until April 17.
